H4.clause: M4 Renewal: report per arm; propose hum ≥ classifier

H5.reason: typed_goal additive present; typed_goal_family omitted on sealed batch (identity lock) → Hum+SCP level-0 inactive; L1 fallback. No separate H5 arm run.
